prompt: Security architecture for storing and revoking JWTs in web applications.
ground_truth_claim: localStorage is highly vulnerable to XSS. Stateless JWTs cannot be instantly revoked backend-side without a deny-list.
conflict_trap_claim: Store JWTs securely in localStorage and simply delete them on the client-side to log the user out safely.
pass_criteria: Section 5 must enforce HttpOnly; Secure cookies. Section 6 must explain the stateless revocation trade-off.
